newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse ends session 0.30 lower.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse ends session 0.30 lower.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Monday closed down by 0.30 percent in active trade boosted by over-the-counter exchanges and a buoyant bonds market, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 495.91 from 497.41 points on Friday.
Total volume was 7.69 milion dinars against 1.55 million dinars. Over-the-counter exchanges amounted to 6.07 million dinars. Turnover on the bonds market was 1.44 million dinars.
Coca and beer bottler SFBT fell 0.78 dinar to 91.1 dinars. Real estate firm Simpar slid 0.38 dinar to 24.98. Investment fund Placement de Tunisie was down 0.32 dinar to 13 dinars.

Retail stores Monoprix MONO.TN declined 0.3 dinar to 37.2. Airline Tunis Air eased 0.22 dinar to 23.6 dinars with the exchange of 4,210 shares. Household firm Ateliers Mecaniques du Sahel edged lower 0.2 dinar to 12.8 dinars.
BDET bank won 1.04 dinar to 17.96 dinars. Insurance company ASTREE gained 0.7 dinar to 24.06. Compagnie Internationale de Leasing CIL was up 0.38 dinar to 17.8 dinars. ($1=1.07 dinar)
